result.query:
SELECT TOP 1 [MBusinessKey] AS [MBusinessKey], [GroupTypeName] AS [GroupTypeName], [GroupName] AS [GroupName], [MeasurementPeriod] AS [MeasurementPeriod], [MeasurementPeriodDate] AS [MeasurementPeriodDate], [Value] AS [Value], [Commentary] AS [Commentary] 
FROM (SELECT 
	  MBusinessKey
	  ,MTypeBusinessKey
      ,[Version]
      ,GroupKey
	  ,MName
    ,GroupTypeName
    ,Indelning_typ_desc
	  ,Enhet
	  ,Kommun
	  ,Region
    ,[GroupName]
    ,[MeasurementPeriod]
	  ,MeasurementPeriodType
	  ,MeasurementPeriodDate
	  ,PeriodStartYear
	  ,PeriodStartQuarter
	  ,IsLastPeriod
	  ,LastPeriodFilterFlag
	  ,Value
	  ,ValueD4
    ,ValueChar
	  ,[numerator] 
	  ,[denominator]
	  ,[cihigh]
	  ,[cilow]
    ,[Commentary]
    ,[DataGenerationDate]
	FROM [semantic].[VAI_NRAS_Trends]
) AS virtual_table GROUP BY [MBusinessKey], [GroupTypeName], [GroupName], [MeasurementPeriod], [MeasurementPeriodDate], [Value], [Commentary];
